title: Add versioned compatibility gate and automated release-summary queue
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Introduces a versioned compatibility-gate that validates model metadata and runtime profiles at intake; adds an automated release-summary queue to synthesize concise changelog bullets and estimated perf/cost deltas for onboarding reviews. Backwards compatible; controlled rollout behind feature flag.
description:
Context: Onboarding model variants has regressed lately when metadata drifted (mismatched kv-cache expectations, incompatible quantization flags) which caused silent fallbacks in Dedicated and spikes in latency during rollouts. This PR implements a versioned compatibility gate (schema + runtime fingerprint checks) that runs during intake and before a model version is marked release-ready, and pairs it with an automated release-summary queue that drafts short changelog bullets with expected latency/cost impact.

What this changes: - intake/compatibility-checker service: evaluates declared model metadata (arch, tokenizer_version, kw_flags, quantization_profile) against a versioned compatibility matrix and recent runtime profiles from the telemetry shard. - release-summary-queue worker: aggregates model deltas, runs a lightweight perf estimator (sequence-length buckets + baseline kernels) and writes a concise release_summary draft into model metadata. - DB migration: adds compatibility_signatures and release_summaries tables (backfill path included). - API: POST /intake/validate -> responds with gate verdict and human-friendly explanation; GET /models/:id/release_summary returns generated summary + suggested release notes. - Feature flag: rollout controlled by feature.toggle.model_compat_gate.

Checklist: [ ] DB migration tested on staging [x] Unit tests for compatibility logic [x] Integration test for intake flow [x] Perf estimator smoke tests [x] Feature-flag gating and telemetry opt-in documented [x] Add docs + examples to onboarding guide (docs/registry/onboard-compat.md)

Commits (summary): - add compat-gate service, initial verifier and proto definitions - worker: release-summary queue + estimator harness - db migration: create compatibility_signatures, release_summaries - api: intake validate endpoint + release_summary read endpoint - tests: unit + integration + perf smoke - docs: onboarding guide and release notes template

Files changed (high level): - services/compatibility/checker.py (new) - services/release_queue/worker.py (new) - api/intake/validators.py (new endpoint) - db/migrations/20241108_add_compat_signatures.sql (new) - schema/models.py (added release_summary fields) - tests/integration/test_intake_gate.py (new) - docs/registry/onboard-compat.md (new) - tools/perf_estimator/estimator.py (new lightweight estimator) - ci/workflows/compat-gate.yml (CI job for integration and perf smoke)

Testing/CI: The new CI workflow runs unit, integration and a perf-smoke that simulates three sequence-length buckets. The branch initially failed the perf-smoke due to an incorrect baseline kernel mapping; fixed in commit "fix estimator kernel mapping" and re-ran. CI now: unit=pass, integration=pass, perf-smoke=pass.

Review conversation (high level): - Marco Nguyen (reviewer): "I like the end-to-end, but can we avoid duplicating the kernel-mapping logic? We already have a kernels registry in infra/runtime. Please reference that instead of copying." -> Author: "Good catch — switched to runtime.kernels.lookup in estimator and added a small adapter; removed duplicate mapping." - Lina Schmidt (reviewer): "Gate verdict messages are great; please add a shorter machine-friendly enum for automation consumers." -> Author: "Added verdict_code enum and updated API docs; included examples in docs." - Evan Rivera (SRE): "DB migration will lock models table; what's the rollout strategy?" -> Author: "Added a non-blocking migration that writes to new tables and backfills in background. Documented the backfill process and added a feature toggle to flip once backfill completes." - Lina: "Approved pending CI" -> final: Approved.

Backward compatibility and migration notes: Migration adds new tables without modifying existing model rows; release_summary is stored separately and surfaced via API. Backfill job runs during low-traffic windows. Feature flag ensures we can turn off checks if there are unexpected regressions.

Risk and mitigation: False positives in compatibility checks could block onboarding. Mitigations: conservative default (warn-only for first 2 weeks), logging + rollout to 10% of intake traffic, and a manual override path for solutions engineers. We added telemetry counters for gate_hits/gate_blocks and dashboard candidates in Console (console/dashboard/compatibility).

Related: ENG-4421 (onboard reliability), ENG-4580 (release automation). Links: linear://ENG-4421 , linear://ENG-4580

Merge: merged via squash on 2024-11-22 after green CI and approvals. Release gated behind feature.toggle.model_compat_gate.
